body.statement: The identity embedding of observed blocks, target, and deterministic training layout satisfies \(\mathcal S_n^{\mathrm{Shen},1}\subset\{\mathbb P\in\mathcal C_n:H_n=1,\ |\mathcal D_{\mathrm{dir},n}|=|\mathcal D_{\mathrm{rec},n}|=1\}\). On this embedded class, selection is deterministic, \(\widehat c_{m,n}(1-\alpha)=\Phi^{-1}(1-\alpha/2)+o_{\Pr}(1)\), and Theorem \(\mathrm{thm{:}uniform\mbox{-}selected\mbox{-}band}\) recovers Shen's published pointwise TWSF interval under the declared Gaussian specialization.
body.justification: This explicit singleton-menu inclusion anchors the growing-path result to the published one-coordinate setup.
body.gap: The recovered pointwise interval is prior-art validation and is not claimed as a new contribution.
body.consumer: It ensures backward compatibility with existing pointwise TWSF reporting.
